The '''Rasmal Valley Palace''' was an opulent palace on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kor Desilijic]] that was maintained by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]] [[Desilijic/Legends|Desilijic]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The palace was one of Kor Desilijic's grandest estates and contained luxury dwellings and entertainment halls that were large enough to hold hundreds of Desilijic Hutts. The palace was named after [[Rasmal Desilijic Bansek]], a Hutt from ancient times who defeated eight other Hutt clans to claim Kor Desilijic for the Desilijic kajidic.<ref name="Lords of Nal Hutta" />
